mission_03: Well done! You have successfully applied both equal-width and equal-frequency binning to continuous variables. You learned how pd.cut() creates bins with custom boundaries and labels, while pd.qcut() ensures equal sample distribution across bins. Binning is a powerful feature engineering technique that can improve model performance by capturing non-linear patterns and reducing noise. Use pd.cut when you have meaningful domain-specific thresholds, and pd.qcut when you want balanced bin sizes for statistical analysis.
